description: Only replace example local paths. artifact: and historical/ IDs are provenance labels and cannot be loaded as files. Paths are relative to this manifest directory or absolute on your machine.

schema.s1: dataset,backbone,seed plus checkpoint, native_neighbors, benchmark_cache. Historical cache adapters may instead supply top50_cache and fullpool_cache separately.
schema.s2: dataset,backbone=MF_BPR,seed plus explicit local split_bundle/test_scores/selected_result. Public S2 outputs require current checkpoint_sha256/test_scores_sha256 because historic saved signatures are absent. Historical signed input may supply complete/parity/selected_profile/checkpoint.
schema.s3_results: Optional dataset,backbone,seed,protocol,method,family,result_path. Otherwise matched source results use --s3-run/runs.
schema.path_map: Explicit exact old input value to current local path, only for relocating external metadata. Never needed for fresh public S3 runs.
